case.title: 设计方向 → 电影感人物作品集
case.author: dammyayans
case.summary: 先附履历、照片和参考图，生成 3 个设计方向，确定字体/颜色/动效后执行。第二条构建指令在 2110400428802191674；含人物视频转滚动帧序列流程。
case.promptSourceText:
2. Give Claude your research. Don’t build yet.

Attach your screenshots/references, resume, photo, and any other relevant documents. Add a colour preference if you have one (e.g. pink). It’s optional.

You can decide to be specific about what you like in each reference: the contact row, the crossing tapes, how the portrait moves, etc.

Then ask Claude to create a design direction artifact first.

Example prompt:

“Create a design direction artifact for this portfolio using the attached materials. Show me 3 distinct directions with font options, colour palettes, and motion ideas.

Explain why each direction fits and what the trade-offs are. Include font previews and colour swatches so I can compare.

Don’t build the website yet.”

promptPosts.text:
5. Now, build.

Tell Claude:

“I’ve selected my options in the artifact. Build the website using those choices.”

For this portfolio, I used React + Vite + Tailwind CSS.

The first iteration is just your starting point. Review it, tweak what doesn’t work, and keep refining until you’re happy with the result.

apiMedia.text:
Built a portfolio website for a brand designer.

No Figma design. No creative direction.

Just her photo and resume.

Used Claude Code to build and Higgsfied to create the cinematic hero film.

I’ve walked a few friends through this process, so I thought I’d share it here too.

If you’ve been wanting to build websites with AI but don’t know where to start, or you’re tired of getting terrible designs, this is for you 👇
